claims: McNeese State University is a public university in Lake Charles, Louisiana.
McNeese State University was founded in 1939.
The athletic teams of McNeese State University are known as the Cowboys and Cowgirls.
The mascot of McNeese State University is Rowdy.
The athletic teams of McNeese State University compete in Division I.
In 2024, the acceptance rate at McNeese State University was approximately 78.27%.
For the 2023-2024 academic year, tuition at McNeese State University was $8,460 for in-state students.
For the 2023-2024 academic year, tuition at McNeese State University was $9,960 for out-of-state students.
McNeese State University has over 60 notable alumni.
Joe Dumars is an NBA player and a notable alumnus of McNeese State University.
Willie Mount is a politician and a notable alumnus of McNeese State University.
Kerry Joseph is a football player and a notable alumnus of McNeese State University.
McNeese State University features a 122-acre main campus in Lake Charles.
McNeese State University has additional farmland.
As of March 2026, the McNeese State Cowboys basketball team was a 12-seed in the NCAA Tournament.
McNeese State University is a member of the University of Louisiana System.
McNeese State University is accredited to offer bachelor's, master's, and specialist degrees.
